~~~yaml
record_id: lammps-fix-fix-langevin-0370
record_type: command
scope: single_software
software:
  - LAMMPS
topic: "fix langevin"
source_type: official_doc
source_ref: https://docs.lammps.org/fix_langevin.html
version_or_doc_date: LAMMPS docs release git info 30Mar2026; checked 2026-05-21
claim: Official LAMMPS documentation lists "fix langevin" under Fix styles.
evidence_level: check
confidence: official
related_wiki: []
related_records:
  - rel-lammps-md-fix-thermostat-chain-0003
  - lammps-fix-fix-nvt-0425
  - lammps-cmd-timestep-0663
note: >
  P4 深化。Langevin 是 VASP AIMD (MDALGO=3) 的 LAMMPS 对应物。
last_checked: 2026-05-24
command_name: "fix langevin"
file_or_context: LAMMPS input script / LAMMPS command reference
definition: >
  Langevin thermostat：对每个原子加随机力（模拟热浴碰撞）和摩擦力（与速度成正比），维持目标温度。Tdamp 控制摩擦强度——Tdamp 越小摩擦力越强（强耦合）。等价于 VASP MDALGO=3 (Langevin)。特别适合非平衡 MD 和含频散模式的体系。
default_behavior: >
  默认: fix ID group-ID langevin temp Tstart Tstop Tdamp seed。
common_use:
  - "含高频模式的水体系: fix 1 all langevin 330 330 0.05 12345"
  - "非平衡 MD (NEMD): Langevin 比 Nose-Hoover 更稳健（不引入共振）"
  - "与 VASP AIMD 对比: VASP MDALGO=3 等价于 LAMMPS fix langevin"
risk_if_misused:
  - >
    Tdamp 过小 → overdamped 动力学 → 扩散系数被人为降低
  - >
    seed 固定但未显式记录 → 不可复现
  - >
    与 fix nvt 比较：Langevin 不产生 Nose-Hoover 共振但动力学随机性更大
related_parameters:
  - timestep
  - fix nvt
source_index: https://docs.lammps.org/Commands_fix.html
source_category: fix
display_name: "langevin"
domain_guidance:
  - rule: "MD equilibration（备选）→ fix langevin; Tdamp ~ 100 × timestep"
    example_status: needs_verification
    applies_to:
      systems: [metal_water_interface]
      tasks: [md_equilibration, non_equilibrium_md]
    value: "fix <ID> all langevin <T> <T> 0.05 <seed>"
    reason: "Langevin 比 Nose-Hoover 更适合高频振动模式和严格非平衡场景"
parameter_relations:
  - target: timestep
    relation: mutually_constrained
    desc: "Tdamp ~ 100 × timestep"
    example_status: needs_verification
  - target: fix nvt
    relation: strengthens
    desc: "Langevin 和 Nose-Hoover 是 alternative thermostats；Langevin 无共振"
    example_status: needs_verification
~~~

~~~yaml
record_id: lammps-fix-fix-npt-0400
record_type: command
scope: single_software
software:
  - LAMMPS
topic: "fix npt"
source_type: official_doc
source_ref: https://docs.lammps.org/fix_nh.html
version_or_doc_date: LAMMPS docs release git info 30Mar2026; checked 2026-05-21
claim: Official LAMMPS documentation lists "fix npt" under Fix styles.
evidence_level: check
confidence: official
related_wiki: []
related_records:
  - rel-lammps-md-fix-thermostat-chain-0003
  - lammps-fix-fix-nvt-0425
  - lammps-cmd-boundary-0571
note: >
  P4 深化。界面水 slab 体系注意 aniso coupling 方向选择。
last_checked: 2026-05-24
command_name: "fix npt"
file_or_context: LAMMPS input script / LAMMPS command reference
definition: >
  NpT（等温等压系综）时间积分器：Nose-Hoover thermostat + barostat 同时控制温度和压力。Pdamp 控制 barostat 耦合强度——Pdamp ~ 1000 × timestep 是经验最优值。适合需要弛豫晶格常数或模拟压力效应的场景。
default_behavior: >
  默认: fix ID group-ID npt temp Tstart Tstop Tdamp iso/aniso/tri Pstart Pstop Pdamp。
common_use:
  - "晶格弛豫: fix 1 all npt temp 300 300 0.1 iso 1.0 1.0 1.0"
  - "界面水 + slab 压力平衡: fix 1 all npt temp 330 330 0.05 aniso 1.0 1.0 1.0"
risk_if_misused:
  - >
    iso coupling + slab → 盒子所有方向同时缩放 → z 方向人工耦合
  - >
    aniso coupling 正确用法: x/y 独立, z 不耦合或独立对——界面体系注意选择性耦合
  - >
    Pdamp 太小 → 压力剧烈振荡 → 盒子尺寸不稳定
  - >
    含真空层的 slab → NpT 可能导致 z 方向无限膨胀→需单方向禁用 barostat
related_parameters:
  - timestep
  - boundary
  - fix nvt
source_index: https://docs.lammps.org/Commands_fix.html
source_category: fix
display_name: "npt"
domain_guidance:
  - rule: "界面水 slab → NpT aniso; z 方向不耦合 (或 p p f + NVT only)"
    example_status: needs_verification
    applies_to:
      systems: [metal_water_interface_slab]
      tasks: [pressure_equilibration]
    value: "fix <ID> all npt temp <T> <T> <Tdamp> aniso <P> <P> <Pdamp>"
    reason: "slab 的 z 方向含真空层，barostat coupling 导致非物理压缩/膨胀"
parameter_relations:
  - target: timestep
    relation: mutually_constrained
    desc: "Pdamp ~ 1000 × timestep"
    example_status: needs_verification
  - target: boundary
    relation: mutually_constrained
    desc: "NpT pressure coupling 方向与 boundary p 方向一致"
    example_status: needs_verification
  - target: fix nvt
    relation: mutually_exclusive
    desc: "NpT 内含 thermostat；不与 NVT 叠加"
    example_status: needs_verification
~~~

~~~yaml
record_id: lammps-fix-fix-nve-0409
record_type: command
scope: single_software
software:
  - LAMMPS
topic: "fix nve"
source_type: official_doc
source_ref: https://docs.lammps.org/fix_nve.html
version_or_doc_date: LAMMPS docs release git info 30Mar2026; checked 2026-05-21
claim: Official LAMMPS documentation lists "fix nve" under Fix styles.
evidence_level: check
confidence: official
related_wiki: []
related_records:
  - rel-lammps-md-fix-thermostat-chain-0003
  - lammps-fix-fix-nvt-0425
  - lammps-fix-fix-langevin-0370
note: >
  P4 深化。NVE 是 MD 生产跑的 gold standard，但前提是力场精度已验证。
last_checked: 2026-05-24
command_name: "fix nve"
file_or_context: LAMMPS input script / LAMMPS command reference
definition: >
  NVE（微正则系综）时间积分器：固定原子数 N、体积 V、总能量 E（无 thermostat 也无 barostat）。Hamiltonian 守恒——理论上是纯动力学轨迹，无外部热浴干扰。适合  力场生产阶段的 production sampling（力足够准确时）。
default_behavior: >
  fix nve 只有一个参数：group-ID。
common_use:
  - "production sampling (): fix 1 all nve"
  - "基准测试（验证力场精度）: 跑 NVE 检验能量守恒"
  - "equilibration 后的采样: fix nvt 平衡 → unfix nvt → fix nve 生产"
risk_if_misused:
  - >
     力不准确 → NVE 能量漂移 → 体系逐渐加热或冷却 → 无 thermostat 纠正
  - >
    NVE 不控温 → 初始动力学不平衡（如局部热斑）⇒ 长时间漂移
  - >
    fix nve 与 fix nvt 同时作用于同一组原子 → LAMMPS 报错
related_parameters:
  - fix nvt
  - fix langevin
  - timestep
source_index: https://docs.lammps.org/Commands_fix.html
source_category: fix
display_name: "nve"
domain_guidance:
  - rule: "MD production run → fix nve（前提: 力已通过 NVT equilibration 验证）"
    example_status: needs_verification
    applies_to:
      systems: [metal_water_interface]
      tasks: [md_production, production_sampling]
    value: "fix 1 all nve"
    reason: "NVE 不引入 thermostat 人工效应，轨迹代表真实 Hamiltonian 动力学"
  - rule: "初始 equilibration → 绝不用 NVE（必须 NVT 或 Langevin 控温）"
    example_status: needs_verification
    applies_to:
      systems: [metal_water_interface]
      tasks: [equilibration]
    value: "fix nvt 或 fix langevin"
    reason: "初始结构远离平衡 → 速度分布非 Maxwell-Boltzmann → NVE 直接跑无意义"
parameter_relations:
  - target: fix nvt
    relation: mutually_exclusive
    desc: "NVE 和 NVT 不能同时作用于同一 group"
    example_status: needs_verification
  - target: timestep
    relation: coupled_accuracy
    desc: "NVE 无 thermostat 纠正 → timestep 必须保守 (≤0.5 fs for MD)"
    example_status: needs_verification
~~~

~~~yaml
record_id: lammps-fix-fix-nvt-0425
record_type: command
scope: single_software
software:
  - LAMMPS
topic: "fix nvt"
source_type: official_doc
source_ref: https://docs.lammps.org/fix_nh.html
version_or_doc_date: LAMMPS docs release git info 30Mar2026; checked 2026-05-21
claim: Official LAMMPS documentation lists "fix nvt" under Fix styles.
evidence_level: check
confidence: official
related_wiki: []
related_records:
  - rel-lammps-md-fix-thermostat-chain-0003
  - lammps-fix-fix-nve-0409
  - lammps-fix-fix-langevin-0370
  - lammps-cmd-timestep-0663
note: >
  P4 深化。Tdamp = 100 × timestep 是核心规则; MD equilibration 首选 Nose-Hoover NVT。
last_checked: 2026-05-24
command_name: "fix nvt"
file_or_context: LAMMPS input script / LAMMPS command reference
definition: >
  NVT（正则系综）时间积分器：Nose-Hoover thermostat 维持温度恒定。Tdamp 控制 thermostat 耦合强度——太小引起虚假振荡，太大耦合过慢。Tdamp ~ 100 × timestep 是经验最优值。
default_behavior: >
  默认: fix ID group-ID nvt temp Tstart Tstop Tdamp。Tstart=Tstop 时恒温，不等时从 Tstart ramp 到 Tstop。
common_use:
  - "equilibration: fix 1 all nvt temp 330 330 0.05"
  - "production (经典力场): fix nvt 作为默认采样系综"
  - "温度 ramp: fix 1 all nvt temp 100 500 0.1 (退火)"
risk_if_misused:
  - >
    Tdamp 过小 (< 10 × timestep) → thermostat 过强 → 高频人工振荡 → RDF 峰宽化
  - >
    Tdamp 过大 (> 1000 × timestep) → thermostat 耦合太慢 → 温度长时间漂移
  - >
    含 H 体系 Tdamp ~ 0.05 ps (~100×0.5fs) 是待目标运行环境验证的起始值
related_parameters:
  - timestep
  - fix nve
  - fix langevin
  - thermo
source_index: https://docs.lammps.org/Commands_fix.html
source_category: fix
display_name: "nvt"
domain_guidance:
  - rule: "MD equilibration → fix nvt, Tdamp = 100 × timestep (0.05 ps for 0.5 fs ts)"
    example_status: needs_verification
    applies_to:
      systems: [metal_water_interface]
      tasks: [md_equilibration]
    value: "fix <ID> all nvt temp <T> <T> 0.05"
    reason: "Tdamp=100×timestep 是 Nose-Hoover 的标准最优值"
parameter_relations:
  - target: timestep
    relation: mutually_constrained
    desc: "Tdamp ~ 100 × timestep"
    example_status: needs_verification
  - target: fix nve
    relation: mutually_exclusive
    desc: "NVT 和 NVE 不能同时作用同一 group"
    example_status: needs_verification
  - target: thermo
    relation: coupled_accuracy
    desc: "fix nvt 的温度输出通过 thermo 监控"
    example_status: needs_verification
~~~

~~~yaml
record_id: lammps-fix-fix-recenter-0475
record_type: command
scope: single_software
software:
  - LAMMPS
topic: "fix recenter"
source_type: official_doc
source_ref: https://docs.lammps.org/fix_recenter.html
version_or_doc_date: LAMMPS docs release git info 30Mar2026; checked 2026-05-21
claim: Official LAMMPS documentation lists "fix recenter" under Fix styles.
evidence_level: check
confidence: official
related_wiki: []
related_records:
  - rel-lammps-md-fix-thermostat-chain-0003
  - lammps-cmd-dump-0589
note: >
  P4 深化。recenter 不影响 MD 力学但对后处理有影响——分析绝对位移时注意 unwrap。
last_checked: 2026-05-24
command_name: "fix recenter"
file_or_context: LAMMPS input script / LAMMPS command reference
definition: >
  周期性重新居中原子坐标——防止 slab/分子在盒子内漂移（如整层 Pt slab 随时间向下沉）。fix recenter INIT INIT INIT 将所有原子质心重置到盒子原点。
default_behavior: >
  fix ID group-ID recenter x y z。可分别控制每轴是否重新居中（INIT 表示回到原点）。
common_use:
  - "slab MD: fix 2 all recenter INIT INIT INIT（防止 slab 沿 z 漂移）"
  - "纳米粒子: fix 2 all recenter INIT INIT INIT（防止粒子漂出盒子）"
  - "MD 界面水: fix 2 all recenter INIT INIT INIT（保持 Pt 层在 z 中心附近）"
risk_if_misused:
  - >
    recenter 破坏了原子的绝对坐标 → dump 轨迹中绝对位移不可用 → 不能直接算 MSD
  - >
    recenter 在每一步都调用 → 力不变但速度方向可能隐含改变 → 对扩散系数有微小影响
  - >
    recenter 后原子可能跨过盒子边界 → 需要至少 neighbor skin 足够覆盖 ~box/2 → 建议用 domain decomposition 替代
related_parameters:
  - dump
  - fix nve
  - fix nvt
source_index: https://docs.lammps.org/Commands_fix.html
source_category: fix
display_name: "recenter"
domain_guidance:
  - rule: "界面水 MD → fix recenter 防止 slab overall translation 漂移"
    example_status: needs_verification
    applies_to:
      systems: [metal_water_interface_slab]
      tasks: [production_md]
    value: "fix <ID> all recenter INIT INIT INIT"
    reason: "slab 整体漂移不贡献界面水统计——移除后轨迹更干净"
parameter_relations:
  - target: dump
    relation: coupled_accuracy
    desc: "dump 的坐标已 recenter → 分析时需要 unwrap 或注意绝对位移意义"
    example_status: needs_verification
  - target: fix nve/nvt
    relation: strengthens
    desc: "fix recenter 叠加在 thermostat 上不修改能量，但影响质心运动"
    example_status: needs_verification
~~~

~~~yaml
record_id: lammps-cmd-atom-style-0566
record_type: command
scope: single_software
software:
  - LAMMPS
topic: "atom_style"
source_type: official_doc
source_ref: https://docs.lammps.org/atom_style.html
version_or_doc_date: LAMMPS docs release git info 30Mar2026; checked 2026-05-21
claim: Official LAMMPS documentation lists "atom_style" under General commands.
evidence_level: check
confidence: official
related_wiki: []
related_records:
  - rel-lammps-md-setup-chain-0001
  - lammps-cmd-read-data-0638
note: >
  P4 深化。ML upstream interface 仅需 atomic style。
last_checked: 2026-05-24
command_name: "atom_style"
file_or_context: LAMMPS input script / LAMMPS command reference
definition: >
  定义 LAMMPS 存储的 per-atom 属性集合（坐标、速度、电荷、分子 ID、键/角信息等）。选定的 atom_style 决定了后续命令可读取和操作的原子属性范围。最简 atomic 仅存坐标+速度+type+质量；charge 增加电荷；full 包含分子拓扑信息。
default_behavior: >
  默认 atom_style atomic（若 input script 未显式设置）。
common_use:
  - "MD (ML 内含电荷信息): atom_style atomic"
  - "离子溶液 + coulomb 长程: atom_style charge"
  - "生物分子/有机: atom_style full"
risk_if_misused:
  - >
    atom_style 与 data 文件格式不匹配 → LAMMPS 报错或静默丢弃属性列
  - >
    MD 中误用 atom_style charge → 冲突——ML 模型内已嵌入电荷
  - >
    含电荷的 data 文件用 atom_style atomic 读取 → 电荷列被忽略
related_parameters:
  - read_data
  - pair_style
source_index: https://docs.lammps.org/Commands_all.html
source_category: general
display_name: "atom_style"
domain_guidance:
  - rule: "MD 仅需坐标+type → atom_style atomic"
    example_status: needs_verification
    applies_to:
      systems: [metal_water_interface]
      tasks: [md]
    value: "atomic"
    reason: "ML 模型内部通过学习原子环境自动处理电荷；LAMMPS 侧不需要显式 charge 属性"
parameter_relations:
  - target: read_data
    relation: prerequisite
    desc: "atom_style 必须在 read_data 之前设置，且两者格式需匹配"
    example_status: needs_verification
  - target: pair_style
    relation: requires_companion
    desc: "某些 pair_style 需要特定 atom_style（如 reaxFF 需要 charge）"
    example_status: needs_verification
~~~

~~~yaml
record_id: lammps-cmd-boundary-0571
record_type: command
scope: single_software
software:
  - LAMMPS
topic: "boundary"
source_type: official_doc
source_ref: https://docs.lammps.org/boundary.html
version_or_doc_date: LAMMPS docs release git info 30Mar2026; checked 2026-05-21
claim: Official LAMMPS documentation lists "boundary" under General commands.
evidence_level: check
confidence: official
related_wiki: []
related_records:
  - rel-lammps-md-setup-chain-0001
  - lammps-cmd-create-box-0580
note: >
  P4 深化。界面水体系 MD 推荐 p p p + 真空层≥15 Å。
last_checked: 2026-05-24
command_name: "boundary"
file_or_context: LAMMPS input script / LAMMPS command reference
definition: >
  设定模拟盒子的边界条件类型：p (periodic 周期性), f (fixed 固定), s (shrink-wrapped 收缩包裹), m (minimum 最小)。三轴 (x y z) 独立设置。slab 模型常设 p p f (z 方向自由，模拟表面+真空)。
default_behavior: >
  默认 boundary p p p（三维周期性）。
common_use:
  - "bulk 体系: p p p"
  - "slab/界面 (z 方向真空): p p f"
  - "纳米线 (x 周期 yz 自由): p f f"
  - "MD 界面水: p p p (真空层足够厚时用周期性避免原子逃逸)"
risk_if_misused:
  - >
    slab 设 p p p 但真空层太薄 → 上下 slab 通过周期性相互作用 → 虚假耦合
  - >
    p p f 模式 z 方向原子热运动飞出盒子 → 需加 fix wall 或增大真空层
  - >
    boundary 类型与 fix npt 的 pressure coupling 方向矛盾
related_parameters:
  - region
  - create_box
  - fix npt/nvt
source_index: https://docs.lammps.org/Commands_all.html
source_category: general
display_name: "boundary"
domain_guidance:
  - rule: "界面水 MD → boundary p p p（真空层≥15 Å）"
    example_status: needs_verification
    applies_to:
      systems: [metal_water_interface]
      tasks: [md]
    value: "p p p"
    reason: "足够厚的真空层确保 z 方向周期性不产生虚假 slab-slab 水桥；p p p 简化 MD 无需 wall fix"
  - rule: "真 slab（z 真空≤10 Å）→ boundary p p f"
    example_status: needs_verification
    applies_to:
      systems: [metal_slab_isolated]
      tasks: [geometry_opt, single_point]
    value: "p p f"
    reason: "薄真空层时周期性会产生虚假 slab-slab 相互作用"
parameter_relations:
  - target: region
    relation: mutually_constrained
    desc: "boundary 选择影响 region 和 create_box 的定义"
    example_status: needs_verification
  - target: fix npt
    relation: mutually_constrained
    desc: "fix npt 的 pressure coupling 方向必须与 boundary 的 p 方向对应"
    example_status: needs_verification
~~~

~~~yaml
record_id: lammps-cmd-compute-0576
record_type: command
scope: single_software
software:
  - LAMMPS
topic: "compute"
source_type: official_doc
source_ref: https://docs.lammps.org/compute.html
version_or_doc_date: LAMMPS docs release git info 30Mar2026; checked 2026-05-21
claim: Official LAMMPS documentation lists "compute" under General commands.
evidence_level: check
confidence: official
related_wiki: []
related_records:
  - lammps-cmd-thermo-style-0660
  - lammps-cmd-dump-0589
note: >
  P4 深化。compute chunk/atom bin/1d z 是界面水密度轮廓分析的标准方法。
last_checked: 2026-05-24
command_name: "compute"
file_or_context: LAMMPS input script / LAMMPS command reference
definition: >
  定义计算（compute）——在 MD 运行中按 step 计算标量、矢量或张量。compute 结果可被 thermo/dump/fix 引用。常用 compute: temp（温度）、pe（势能）、ke（动能）、pressure（压力）、rdf（径向分布函数）、msd（均方位移）、chunk/atom（空间分区属性）。
default_behavior: >
  无默认——compute 是可选的。若未定义 compute temp、pe 等，thermo 使用内部默认计算。
common_use:
  - "compute myTemp all temp（温度计算）"
  - "compute myRDF all rdf 100 1 2（type 1-2 的 RDF）"
  - "compute chunkAll all chunk/atom bin/1d z lower 0.1（z 方向分层）"
  - "compute myPE all pe（势能）"
risk_if_misused:
  - >
    compute 定义了但未在 thermo_style 中引用 → 被静默忽略（不影响结果但浪费计算）
  - >
    compute rdf 的 bin 数过大 → 内存暴涨
  - >
    compute chunk/atom 的 bin 宽度过小 → 每 bin 少于 ~10 atoms → RDF/密度噪声大
related_parameters:
  - thermo_style
  - dump
  - region
source_index: https://docs.lammps.org/Commands_all.html
source_category: general
display_name: "compute"
domain_guidance:
  - rule: "界面水后处理: compute chunk/atom bin/1d z → z-dependent density/RDF"
    example_status: needs_verification
    applies_to:
      systems: [metal_water_interface]
      tasks: [density_profile, rdf_analysis]
    value: "compute cChunk all chunk/atom bin/1d z lower 0.1"
    reason: "z 方向 ~0.1 Å 分辨率足以分辨界面水 2-3 层结构"
parameter_relations:
  - target: thermo_style
    relation: requires_companion
    desc: "compute 定义后需在 thermo_style 中引用才能输出"
    example_status: needs_verification
  - target: dump
    relation: requires_companion
    desc: "compute 可被 dump 引用输出 per-atom 计算结果"
    example_status: needs_verification
  - target: region
    relation: requires_companion
    desc: "compute reduce region 按空间区域聚合"
    example_status: needs_verification
~~~

record_id: lammps-cmd-create-atoms-0578

claim: Official LAMMPS documentation lists "create_atoms" under General commands.
evidence_level: check
confidence: official
related_wiki: []
related_records:
  - lammps-cmd-create-box-0580
  - lammps-cmd-minimize-0617
note: >
  P4 深化。MD 管线推荐用 Packmol/ASE 生成初始结构而非 create_atoms random。
last_checked: 2026-05-24
command_name: "create_atoms"
file_or_context: LAMMPS input script / LAMMPS command reference
definition: >
  在盒子内按给定方式创建原子：单个原子、随机分布、按 lattice 排布（如 fcc/bcc/sc）、或在指定 region 内填充。用于从头构建模拟体系。
default_behavior: >
  无默认。
common_use:
  - "create_atoms 1 random 1000 12345 waterRegion（在 water region 随机放 1000 个 type-1 原子）"
  - "create_atoms 2 box（全盒均匀填充 type-2 原子）"
risk_if_misused:
  - >
    random 创建的原子可能过度重叠 → 第一步力极大 → 爆炸
  - >
    create_atoms 的 type 未在 create_box ntypes 中 → 报错
  - >
    create_atoms 后未做 minimize → MD 直接从重叠结构运行 → 非物理能量 → NaN
related_parameters:
  - create_box
  - region
  - minimize
source_index: https://docs.lammps.org/Commands_all.html
source_category: general
display_name: "create_atoms"
domain_guidance:
  - rule: "MD: 避免 create_atoms random 创建水分子——用 Packmol 构建初始构型再转 data 文件"
    example_status: needs_verification
    applies_to:
      systems: [metal_water_interface]
      tasks: [md]
    value: "Packmol/ASE → data 文件"
    reason: "create_atoms random 无法保证水分子内 O-H 键长和 H-O-H 角度正确，导致 MD 第一步能量异常"
parameter_relations:
  - target: create_box
    relation: prerequisite
    desc: "create_atoms 在 create_box 创建的盒子内放置原子"
    example_status: needs_verification
  - target: region
    relation: requires_companion
    desc: "region 限定 create_atoms 的空间范围"
    example_status: needs_verification
  - target: minimize
    relation: requires_companion
    desc: "create_atoms 后必须先做能量最小化消除原子重叠"
    example_status: needs_verification

~~~yaml
record_id: lammps-cmd-dump-0589
record_type: command
scope: single_software
software:
  - LAMMPS
topic: "dump"
source_type: official_doc
source_ref: https://docs.lammps.org/dump.html
version_or_doc_date: LAMMPS docs release git info 30Mar2026; checked 2026-05-21
claim: Official LAMMPS documentation lists "dump" under General commands.
evidence_level: check
confidence: official
related_wiki: []
related_records:
  - lammps-cmd-dump-modify-0590
  - lammps-cmd-thermo-0658
note: >
  P4 深化。MD 推荐 dump custom 100 文本格式（ASE/VMD 兼容性最好）。
last_checked: 2026-05-24
command_name: "dump"
file_or_context: LAMMPS input script / LAMMPS command reference
definition: >
  定义原子轨迹输出——每 M 步将选定原子的属性（坐标、速度、力、per-atom compute 值）写入 dump 文件。dump 文件格式: custom（文本）、atom（LAMMPS 二进制）、netcdf、xyz 等。
default_behavior: >
  无默认——必须显式定义 dump 才有轨迹输出。
common_use:
  - "MD: dump 1 all custom 100 dump.lammpstrj id type x y z"
  - "含力输出: dump 1 all custom 100 dump.lammpstrj id type x y z fx fy fz"
risk_if_misused:
  - >
    dump 频率太高 → single trajectory 文件 GB 级 → post-processing 工具（VMD/ASE）崩
  - >
    dump 频率太低 → 时间分辨率不足以捕捉快速动力学（质子 transfer ~fs）
  - >
    dump 未定义 → 跑了 MD 但没有轨迹文件 → 大量计算资源浪费
  - >
    dump_modify sort id 遗忘 → 原子顺序在各 step 打乱 → 分析时需额外 reorder
related_parameters:
  - dump_modify
  - thermo
  - run
source_index: https://docs.lammps.org/Commands_all.html
source_category: general
display_name: "dump"
domain_guidance:
  - rule: "MD production: dump every 100 steps (~50 fs) + dump_modify sort id"
    example_status: needs_verification
    applies_to:
      tasks: [md_production]
    value: "dump 1 all custom 100 dump.lammpstrj id type x y z"
    reason: "50 fs 分辨率足够 resolve 水分子旋转 (ps timescale) 且文件大小可控"
parameter_relations:
  - target: dump_modify
    relation: requires_companion
    desc: "dump_modify 修改 dump 输出行为"
    example_status: needs_verification
  - target: thermo
    relation: coupled_accuracy
    desc: "dump 和 thermo 频率独立，但两者 IO 叠加"
    example_status: needs_verification
  - target: run
    relation: mutually_constrained
    desc: "run steps / dump freq = dump frames 总数"
    example_status: needs_verification
~~~

~~~yaml
record_id: lammps-cmd-dump-modify-0590
record_type: command
scope: single_software
software:
  - LAMMPS
topic: "dump_modify"
source_type: official_doc
source_ref: https://docs.lammps.org/dump_modify.html
version_or_doc_date: LAMMPS docs release git info 30Mar2026; checked 2026-05-21
claim: Official LAMMPS documentation lists "dump_modify" under General commands.
evidence_level: check
confidence: official
related_wiki: []
related_records:
  - lammps-cmd-dump-0589
note: >
  P4 深化。sort id 是后处理便利性的必备选项。
last_checked: 2026-05-24
command_name: "dump_modify"
file_or_context: LAMMPS input script / LAMMPS command reference
definition: >
  修改 dump 输出行为：sort id（按时原子 ID 排序输出）、every/element（选择性输出某些原子类型）、region（按 region 过滤）、flush yes（每个 dump step 强制写盘）。
default_behavior: >
  无默认（不自动 sort，不自动 flush）。
common_use:
  - "dump_modify 1 sort id（输出前按 atom ID 排序→跨帧原子一致）"
  - "dump_modify 1 element Pt H O（按元素名标记输出列）"
  - "dump_modify 1 flush yes（每个 dump 立即写盘，防止 crash 丢失数据）"
risk_if_misused:
  - >
    sort id 每次 dump 都排序 → N atom 下 O(N log N) → 对 >10k atoms 体系有可观开销
  - >
    element 标记的元素名与 data 文件不一致 → 标注错误
  - >
    flush yes + 高频 dump → 频繁 flush 降低写盘性能
related_parameters:
  - dump
source_index: https://docs.lammps.org/Commands_all.html
source_category: general
display_name: "dump_modify"
domain_guidance:
  - rule: "MD: dump_modify 1 sort id（确保每帧原子 ID 对齐）"
    example_status: needs_verification
    applies_to:
      tasks: [md]
    value: "dump_modify 1 sort id"
    reason: "sort id 使后处理无需每帧重新排序——ASE/VMD 直接解析更快"
parameter_relations:
  - target: dump
    relation: prerequisite
    desc: "必须先定义 dump 才能 modify"
    example_status: needs_verification
~~~

~~~yaml
record_id: lammps-cmd-group-0597
record_type: command
scope: single_software
software:
  - LAMMPS
topic: "group"
source_type: official_doc
source_ref: https://docs.lammps.org/group.html
version_or_doc_date: LAMMPS docs release git info 30Mar2026; checked 2026-05-21
claim: Official LAMMPS documentation lists "group" under General commands.
evidence_level: check
confidence: official
related_wiki: []
related_records:
  - lammps-cmd-region-0641
  - rel-lammps-md-setup-chain-0001
note: >
  P4 深化。空间-化学双维度分组是界面水 MD 后处理的核心前提。
last_checked: 2026-05-24
command_name: "group"
file_or_context: LAMMPS input script / LAMMPS command reference
definition: >
  将原子分配到命名组。组可按类型、region、ID 范围或逻辑运算（union/intersect/subtract）定义。fix/compute/dump 等后续命令通过 group-ID 限定作用范围。
default_behavior: >
  默认 all group 包含全部原子。
common_use:
  - "group Pt type 1（Pt 原子组）"
  - "group water type 2 3（O+H 原子组）"
  - "group slabMol molecule 1:160（分子/层分组）"
  - "group interface region waterRegion（水-界面接触层）"
risk_if_misused:
  - >
    group 命令越早越好的原则被忽略 → 后续 fix 引用未定义的 group → 报错
  - >
    group 的 subtract 逻辑写反 → 预期排除 A 实际排除了 B
  - >
    动态创建的原子（如 fix bond/create）不在已有 group 中 → 新的 fix 作用不到
related_parameters:
  - region
  - fix
  - compute
  - dump
source_index: https://docs.lammps.org/Commands_all.html
source_category: general
display_name: "group"
domain_guidance:
  - rule: "界面水 MD: 按元素 + 空间位置双维度分组 (Pt slab / interface water / bulk water)"
    example_status: needs_verification
    applies_to:
      systems: [metal_water_interface]
      tasks: [md, rdf_analysis, density_profile]
    value: "group-based segregation"
    reason: "不同层的温度/配位数/H-bond 行为不同，分组后可分别分析"
parameter_relations:
  - target: region
    relation: requires_companion
    desc: "region 定义空间 → group + region 实现空间+类型双重过滤"
    example_status: needs_verification
  - target: fix nvt/npt
    relation: mutually_constrained
    desc: "fix 可作用于特定 group; 常见用法: metal 和 water 用不同 thermostat"
    example_status: needs_verification
  - target: compute
    relation: requires_companion
    desc: "compute temp/ke/pe group_ID 对特定组做热力学量计算"
    example_status: needs_verification
~~~

record_id: lammps-cmd-include-0603
record_type: command

  - LAMMPS
topic: "include"
source_type: official_doc

version_or_doc_date: LAMMPS docs release git info 30Mar2026; checked 2026-05-21
claim: Official LAMMPS documentation lists "include" under General commands.
evidence_level: check
confidence: official
related_wiki: []
related_records:
  - lammps-cmd-variable-0668
note: >
  P4 深化。
last_checked: 2026-05-24
command_name: "include"
file_or_context: LAMMPS input script / LAMMPS command reference
definition: >
  在 LAMMPS 输入脚本中引用外部文件（作为子脚本插入当前位置执行）。用于模块化输入——将 pair_style/pair_coeff、group 定义、fix 设置等拆分到独立文件。
default_behavior: >
  include <filename> — 读取指定文件并立即逐行执行。
common_use:
  - "include pair_ml.in（pair style + coeff 单独文件）"
  - "include fix_nvt.in（thermostat 设置独立管理）"
risk_if_misused:
  - >
    include 文件路径错误 → LAMMPS 报 'Cannot open file'
  - >
    include 循环嵌套（A 包含 B 包含 A）→ 无限循环 → 堆栈溢出
  - >
    include 的内容与当前上下文不兼容（如变量未定义）
related_parameters:
  - variable
source_index: https://docs.lammps.org/Commands_all.html
source_category: general
display_name: "include"
domain_guidance:
  - rule: "MD: 将 pair 设置提取到独立文件 → 换模型只需改一行 include"
    example_status: needs_verification
    applies_to:
      tasks: [md]
    value: "include pair_ml.in"
    reason: "模块化管理 force field 设置——切换不同 potential model 只需改 include 路径"
parameter_relations:
  - target: variable
    relation: strengthens
    desc: "include 文件中可使用 variable 替代硬编码"
    example_status: needs_verification

~~~yaml
record_id: lammps-cmd-minimize-0617
record_type: command
scope: single_software
software:
  - LAMMPS
topic: "minimize"
source_type: official_doc
source_ref: https://docs.lammps.org/minimize.html
version_or_doc_date: LAMMPS docs release git info 30Mar2026; checked 2026-05-21
claim: Official LAMMPS documentation lists "minimize" under General commands.
evidence_level: check
confidence: official
related_wiki: []
related_records:
  - lammps-cmd-velocity-0669
  - lammps-cmd-pair-coeff-0627
note: >
  P4 深化。MD 最小化用 fire 算法最速；精度不须过紧。
last_checked: 2026-05-24
command_name: "minimize"
file_or_context: LAMMPS input script / LAMMPS command reference
definition: >
  能量最小化——调整原子坐标使体系势能降至局部极小值（零温度）。算法: cg（共轭梯度）、quickmin、sd（最速下降）、fire。在 MD 启动前消除原子重叠（如 Packmol 构建的水体系 → 部分分子间距离过近）。
default_behavior: >
  默认: minimize etol ftol maxiter maxeval。etol=1e-4（能量容差），ftol=1e-6（力容差）。
common_use:
  - "MD 前最小化: minimize 1e-4 1e-6 1000 10000"
  - "cg 优化: minimize 1e-6 1e-8 5000 50000（严格收敛）"
risk_if_misused:
  - >
    minimize 的 etol/ftol 与 ML 模型精度不匹配 → 对  过紧收敛无意义（模型力精度本身 ~meV/Å）
  - >
    minimize 后直接 start MD → 体系零温 → 需要 velocity create 重新初始化速度
  - >
    ML 最小化中 Box 可能被 fit → 导致意外盒子畸变
related_parameters:
  - pair_coeff
  - velocity
  - timestep
source_index: https://docs.lammps.org/Commands_all.html
source_category: general
display_name: "minimize"
domain_guidance:
  - rule: "MD 前 min: etol=1e-4 ftol=1e-6 + fire (速度最快 + potential 安全)"
    example_status: needs_verification
    applies_to:
      tasks: [md_prep]
    value: "minimize 1e-4 1e-6 1000 10000"
    reason: " 力精度 ~meV/Å → ftol 设为 1e-6 eV/Å 足够（无需经典力场级 tighter tolerance）"
parameter_relations:
  - target: pair_coeff
    relation: prerequisite
    desc: "minimize 需要 pair_coeff 有效的力场"
    example_status: needs_verification
  - target: velocity
    relation: requires_companion
    desc: "minimize 后 velocity 归零 → 需 velocity create 重新初始化"
    example_status: needs_verification
~~~

~~~yaml
record_id: lammps-cmd-neigh-modify-0622
record_type: command
scope: single_software
software:
  - LAMMPS
topic: "neigh_modify"
source_type: official_doc
source_ref: https://docs.lammps.org/neigh_modify.html
version_or_doc_date: LAMMPS docs release git info 30Mar2026; checked 2026-05-21
claim: Official LAMMPS documentation lists "neigh_modify" under General commands.
evidence_level: check
confidence: official
related_wiki: []
related_records:
  - rel-lammps-md-setup-chain-0001

  - lammps-cmd-neighbor-0623
note: >
  P4 深化。potential 场景下 every 1 delay 0 是硬性要求。
last_checked: 2026-05-24
command_name: "neigh_modify"
file_or_context: LAMMPS input script / LAMMPS command reference
definition: >
  修改 Verlet 邻居列表的构建策略：every（每 N 步重建）、delay（最快延迟多少步重建）、check（是否检查邻居完整性）、exclude（排除特定原子对）。在 MD 中通常 every 1 delay 0 check yes——每步重建以确保 potential 评估所有贡献对。
default_behavior: >
  默认 neigh_modify every 1 delay 10 check yes。delay=10 意为若前一步无原子移动 > skin/2 则可延迟最多 10 步重建。
common_use:
  - "MD: neigh_modify every 1 delay 0 check yes（每步重建）"
  - "经典力场 MD: 保持默认（delay 10）"
  - "分子晶体优化: neigh_modify every 1 delay 0"
risk_if_misused:
  - >
    delay 不为 0 + potential → 某个 step 邻居列表不完整 → 丢失近邻力贡献 → 能量/力错误
  - >
    check yes → 检查到原子位移 > skin/2 时报错退出 → 安全但对剧烈重构体系过于保守
  - >
    exclude 误用 → 排除本应交互的原子对
related_parameters:
  - neighbor
  - pair_style <potential>
source_index: https://docs.lammps.org/Commands_all.html
source_category: general
display_name: "neigh_modify"
domain_guidance:
  - rule: "potential (potential) → neigh_modify every 1 delay 0 check yes"
    example_status: needs_verification
    applies_to:
      systems: [metal_water_interface]
      tasks: [md]
    value: "every 1 delay 0 check yes"
    reason: "potential 每步力评估依赖完整邻居列表；任何延迟都可能使能量/力不一致"
parameter_relations:
  - target: neighbor
    relation: requires_companion
    desc: "neighbor 设 skin，neigh_modify 控 rebuild 策略——两者配套"
    example_status: needs_verification
  - target: pair_style <potential>
    relation: coupled_accuracy
    desc: "ML cutoff 内所有 neighbor 必须全部纳入 pair 评估"
    example_status: needs_verification
~~~

~~~yaml
record_id: lammps-cmd-neighbor-0623
record_type: command
scope: single_software
software:
  - LAMMPS
topic: "neighbor"
source_type: official_doc
source_ref: https://docs.lammps.org/neighbor.html
version_or_doc_date: LAMMPS docs release git info 30Mar2026; checked 2026-05-21
claim: Official LAMMPS documentation lists "neighbor" under General commands.
evidence_level: check
confidence: official
related_wiki: []
related_records:
  - rel-lammps-md-setup-chain-0001

note: >
  P4 深化。MD 标准组合: neighbor 2.0 bin + neigh_modify every 1 delay 0。
last_checked: 2026-05-24
command_name: "neighbor"
file_or_context: LAMMPS input script / LAMMPS command reference
definition: >
  设置 Verlet 邻居列表的参数：skin distance（皮肤距离）和 neighbor style（bin/nsq/multi）。neighbor 控制成对相互作用的计算效率和准确性。skin 越大 → rebuild 频率越低但 pair 评估更多原子对；skin 太小 → rebuild 频繁 → 开销大。
default_behavior: >
  默认 neighbor 2.0 bin（skin=2.0 Å, bin sorting）。
common_use:
  - "MD: neighbor 2.0 bin"
  - "大体系 (>100k atoms): neighbor 3.0 bin（减少 rebuild）"
risk_if_misused:
  - >
    skin 太小 + potential model → rebuild 频繁 → 每步都在构建邻居列表 → 性能从 GPU-bound 变 CPU-bound
  - >
    skin 太大 → 每步评估过多的 non-contributing 原子对 → GPU 算力浪费
  - >
    bin vs nsq: nsq 适合 <1000 atoms, bin 适合大体系
related_parameters:
  - neigh_modify
  - pair_style <potential>
  - timestep
source_index: https://docs.lammps.org/Commands_all.html
source_category: general
display_name: "neighbor"
domain_guidance:
  - rule: "MD → neighbor 2.0 bin + neigh_modify every 1 delay 0"
    example_status: needs_verification
    applies_to:
      systems: [metal_water_interface]
      tasks: [md]
    value: "2.0 bin"
    reason: "skin=2.0 Å 在 potential cutoff (~5-6 Å) 和 rebuild 频率间取得平衡"
parameter_relations:
  - target: neigh_modify
    relation: requires_companion
    desc: "neighbor 设 skin size; neigh_modify 控 rebuild 策略"
    example_status: needs_verification
  - target: pair_style
    relation: coupled_accuracy
    desc: "ML cutoff 越大 → skin 可以取更大值 → 更少 rebuild"
    example_status: needs_verification
  - target: timestep
    relation: coupled_accuracy
    desc: "timestep 越短 → 每步位移越小 → skin 内可以容忍更多步 → rebuild 需求降低"
    example_status: needs_verification
~~~

last_checked: 2026-05-24
command_name: "newton"
file_or_context: LAMMPS input script / LAMMPS command reference
definition: >
  控制 Newton's Third Law 开关——on 时每对原子间力只计算一次（对称地施加于两个原子），off 时每对力独立计算。Newton on 提高性能；但某些 pair_style（含 potential）与某些加速模式（Kokkos）下必须 newton off。
default_behavior: >
  默认 newton on。
common_use:
  - "经典力场 + MPI: newton on（性能最优）"
  - "Kokkos + potential: newton off（已知冲突）"
  - "含 ghost atoms 的 pair style: newton off（避免重复计数）"
risk_if_misused:
  - >
    Kokkos + potential + newton on → 可能能量不守恒或 segfault；须按上游文档与目标运行环境验证
  - >
    newton on + pair_style 不支持单侧力分配 → 力重复或遗漏
  - >
    newton off → 计算量翻倍 → GPU 利用率下降但仍可用（双 GPU 时 GPU 温度可能上升）
related_parameters:
  - pair_style <potential>
  - pair_coeff
source_index: https://docs.lammps.org/Commands_all.html
source_category: general
display_name: "newton"
domain_guidance:
  - rule: "双 GPU Kokkos + potential → newton off"
    example_status: needs_verification
    applies_to:
      systems: [metal_water_interface]
      tasks: [md]
      gpu: 2×3060Ti
      accelerator: Kokkos
    value: "off"
    reason: "Kokkos + potential + newton on 三重组合存在已知冲突，导致能量不守恒"
  - rule: "ML upstream 非 Kokkos → newton on (默认)"
    example_status: needs_verification
    applies_to:
      systems: [metal_water_interface]
      tasks: [md]
      accelerator: non-Kokkos
    value: "on"
    reason: "无 Kokkos 时 potential pair style 与 newton on 兼容，性能更优"
parameter_relations:
  - target: pair_style <potential>
    relation: mutually_exclusive
    desc: "Kokkos 加速模式下 newton on 与 potential pair style 冲突"
    example_status: needs_verification
  - target: run (Kokkos flags)
    relation: mutually_constrained
    desc: "lmp -k on g 2 -sf kk -pk kokkos newton off 的 newton off 与输入脚本中的 newton 一致"
    example_status: needs_verification
~~~

~~~yaml
record_id: lammps-cmd-pair-coeff-0627
record_type: command
scope: single_software
software:
  - LAMMPS
topic: "pair_coeff"
source_type: official_doc
source_ref: https://docs.lammps.org/pair_coeff.html
version_or_doc_date: LAMMPS docs release git info 30Mar2026; checked 2026-05-21
claim: Official LAMMPS documentation lists "pair_coeff" under General commands.
evidence_level: check
confidence: official
related_wiki: []
related_records:

  - lammps-cmd-pair-style-0629
  - lammps-cmd-read-data-0638
note: >
  P4 深化。pair_coeff 元素列表顺序与 data 文件中 atom types 顺序一致是静默错误高风险点。
last_checked: 2026-05-24
command_name: "pair_coeff"
file_or_context: LAMMPS input script / LAMMPS command reference
definition: >
  为 pair_style 指定的力场类型设置系数/参数。在 pair_style <potential> 下，pair_coeff 指定 potential model 文件路径和元素映射顺序。对于经典力场，pair_coeff 设置 epsilon/sigma/cutoff 等 LJ 参数。
default_behavior: >
  无默认。必须显式设置，且元素顺序须与 data 文件中 atom types 一致。
common_use:
  - "MD: pair_coeff * * <model_file> H O Pt potential"
  - "LJ 力场: pair_coeff 1 2 0.1 3.0 12.0 (epsilon=0.1, sigma=3.0, cutoff=12.0)"
risk_if_misused:
  - >
    potential model 文件路径错误或文件不存在 → 'Cannot open model file'
  - >
    元素列表顺序与 data 文件中的 atom types 不一致 → 错误元素映射→所有能量/力错误而无报错
  - >
    potential model 文件的 dtype (float64/float32) 与训练时 default_dtype 不一致
  - >
    * * 通配符覆盖所有对 → 混合元素体系中可能误覆盖已定义的对系数
related_parameters:
  - pair_style
  - read_data
  - atom_style
source_index: https://docs.lammps.org/Commands_all.html
source_category: general
display_name: "pair_coeff"
domain_guidance:
  - rule: "potential model 已转 float32 → pair_coeff 直接使用"
    example_status: needs_verification
    applies_to:
      systems: [metal_water_interface]
      tasks: [md]
    value: "pair_coeff * * <model_file> <element_list> potential"
    reason: "预置 float32 model 可直接用于 potential-LAMMPS inferencing"
parameter_relations:
  - target: pair_style
    relation: prerequisite
    desc: "pair_style 必须先于 pair_coeff 声明"
    example_status: needs_verification
  - target: read_data
    relation: mutually_constrained
    desc: "data 文件中 atom types 顺序 = pair_coeff 中元素列表顺序"
    example_status: needs_verification
  - target: atom_style
    relation: prerequisite
    desc: "atom_style atomic 下 pair_coeff 无 charge 系数"
    example_status: needs_verification
~~~

~~~yaml
record_id: lammps-cmd-read-data-0638
record_type: command
scope: single_software
software:
  - LAMMPS
topic: "read_data"
source_type: official_doc
source_ref: https://docs.lammps.org/read_data.html
version_or_doc_date: LAMMPS docs release git info 30Mar2026; checked 2026-05-21
claim: Official LAMMPS documentation lists "read_data" under General commands.
evidence_level: check
confidence: official
related_wiki: []
related_records:
  - rel-lammps-md-setup-chain-0001
  - lammps-cmd-atom-style-0566
  - lammps-cmd-pair-coeff-0627
note: >
  P4 深化。MD 用 ASE 生成 data 文件最为可靠。
last_checked: 2026-05-24
command_name: "read_data"
file_or_context: LAMMPS input script / LAMMPS command reference
definition: >
  从外部 data 文件读取模拟体系的全部初始信息：原子坐标、盒子尺寸、原子类型与质量、拓扑（键/角/二面角）、力场参数（非键系数）等。data 文件格式取决于 atom_style。
default_behavior: >
  无默认——必须指定 data 文件路径。add/offset 等参数控制原子 ID 偏移。
common_use:
  - "MD: read_data system.data（从 ASE/VASP CONTCAR 转换）"
  - "经典 MD: read_data polymer.data（含 bond/angle 拓扑）"
risk_if_misused:
  - >
    data 文件格式与 atom_style 不匹配 → 读取阶段报错
  - >
    data 文件中元素类型顺序与 pair_coeff 中不一致 → 力场参数映射错误 → 静默错误
  - >
    data 文件盒子尺寸与 ASE/POSCAR 源不一致 → 初始密度/压力偏斜
  - >
    从 VASP CONTCAR 转 data 时未处理 selective dynamics 标记
related_parameters:
  - atom_style
  - pair_coeff
  - mass
source_index: https://docs.lammps.org/Commands_all.html
source_category: general
display_name: "read_data"
domain_guidance:
  - rule: "MD: data 文件从 ASE read POSCAR → write lammps-data 生成"
    example_status: needs_verification
    applies_to:
      systems: [metal_water_interface]
      tasks: [md]
    value: "ASE io.lammpsdata.write_lammps_data()"
    reason: "ASE 自动处理 atom_style atomic 格式、元素类型映射、盒子向量"
parameter_relations:
  - target: atom_style
    relation: prerequisite
    desc: "data 文件格式必须与 atom_style 匹配"
    example_status: needs_verification
  - target: pair_coeff
    relation: requires_companion
    desc: "data 文件中的 atom types 顺序决定了 pair_coeff 中的元素列表顺序"
    example_status: needs_verification
  - target: mass
    relation: overrides
    desc: "若 data 文件含 Masses 段，mass 命令可省略"
    example_status: needs_verification
~~~

confidence: official

related_records:
  - lammps-cmd-write-restart-0674
note: >
  P4 深化。从一个 restart 继续跑需要在 read_restart 后重新定义 fix/thermo/dump。
last_checked: 2026-05-24
command_name: "read_restart"
file_or_context: LAMMPS input script / LAMMPS command reference
definition: >
  从之前的 write_restart 文件恢复 MD 状态并继续运行。恢复的信息包括: 原子坐标、速度、盒子尺寸、atom_style、force field 参数、fix 状态、当前 seed 等。
default_behavior: >
  read_restart <filename>。
common_use:
  - "equil → prod 续跑: read_restart restart.equil → run 200000"
  - "checkpoint 恢复: read_restart restart.100ps → run 100000"
risk_if_misused:
  - >
    read_restart 后改变了任何不可重启的设置（如 pair_style）→ 状态冲突
  - >
    restart 文件来自不同 LAMMPS 版本 / 不同 atom_style → 无法读取
  - >
    read_restart 后 fix nvt/npt 等需要重新定义
related_parameters:
  - write_restart
source_index: https://docs.lammps.org/Commands_all.html
source_category: general
display_name: "read_restart"

parameter_relations:

~~~yaml
record_id: lammps-cmd-region-0641
record_type: command
scope: single_software
software:
  - LAMMPS
topic: "region"
source_type: official_doc
source_ref: https://docs.lammps.org/region.html
version_or_doc_date: LAMMPS docs release git info 30Mar2026; checked 2026-05-21
claim: Official LAMMPS documentation lists "region" under General commands.
evidence_level: check
confidence: official
related_wiki: []
related_records:
  - lammps-cmd-group-0597
  - lammps-cmd-boundary-0571
note: >
  P4 深化。界面水分析中 region 是空间分区分析的基础工具。
last_checked: 2026-05-24
command_name: "region"
file_or_context: LAMMPS input script / LAMMPS command reference
definition: >
  定义一个几何区域（block/sphere/cylinder/cone/union/intersect），后续命令（group/create_atoms/fix wall/compute）可引用 region 限定空间范围。slab 体系中常用 region 区分 slab 区域和水区域。
default_behavior: >
  无默认——region 是可选的辅助命令。
common_use:
  - "slab 分区: region slab block INF INF INF INF 0 10 (z=0-10Å)"
  - "水层识别: region water block INF INF INF INF 10 30"
  - "fix wall: fix wallRegion all lj126 region boundary"
risk_if_misused:
  - >
    region 边界与实际 slab/水界面位置不对应 → 分区分析错误
  - >
    periodic 体系设 region 下限=上限 → 零厚度 region → 无原子匹配
  - >
    region 定义的侧 (side in/out) 与 group 或 fix 的意图相反
related_parameters:
  - group
  - boundary
  - compute
  - fix wall
source_index: https://docs.lammps.org/Commands_all.html
source_category: general
display_name: "region"
domain_guidance:
  - rule: "Pt(111)-水界面: region 分区可按 z 坐标划分 slab/interface/water/bulk-like water"
    example_status: needs_verification
    applies_to:
      systems: [metal_water_interface]
      tasks: [rdf_analysis, density_profile]
    value: "region-based binning"
    reason: "region 分区 + compute chunk/atom 可做 z-dependent RDF/密度分析"
parameter_relations:
  - target: group
    relation: requires_companion
    desc: "region 定义空间范围 → group 将 region 内原子分配为组"
    example_status: needs_verification
  - target: compute chunk/atom
    relation: requires_companion
    desc: "compute chunk/atom + region → 空间分区属性计算"
    example_status: needs_verification
  - target: boundary
    relation: mutually_constrained
    desc: "boundary p p f 下 z 方向固定边界与 region 的 z 范围相关"
    example_status: needs_verification
~~~

record_id: lammps-cmd-reset-timestep-0646
record_type: command
scope: single_software

source_type: official_doc

version_or_doc_date: LAMMPS docs release git info 30Mar2026; checked 2026-05-21
claim: Official LAMMPS documentation lists "reset_timestep" under General commands.
evidence_level: check
confidence: official
related_wiki: []
related_records:
  - lammps-cmd-read-restart-0640
  - lammps-cmd-run-0648
note: >
  P4 深化。production run 前重置 timestep 使 log 更清晰。
last_checked: 2026-05-24
command_name: "reset_timestep"
file_or_context: LAMMPS input script / LAMMPS command reference
definition: >
  重置内部 MD 步计数器为零（或在 read_restart 后设为指定值）。不影响坐标/速度/力——只影响步计数。用于重启后的步数跟踪或清除之前步数。
default_behavior: >
  reset_timestep 0（重置到零）。
common_use:
  - "restart 续跑后: reset_timestep 0（重新计数生产步）"
  - "合并多段: reset_timestep 100000（从第 10 万步继续）"
risk_if_misused:
  - >
    在 simulation 中途 reset_timestep → dump 文件 step 编号回滚 → 后处理混淆
  - >
    reset_timestep 后 thermo 输出的 step 重新从 0 开始
related_parameters:
  - read_restart
  - run
  - timestep
source_index: https://docs.lammps.org/Commands_all.html
source_category: general
display_name: "reset_timestep"
domain_guidance:
  - rule: "restart + production: reset_timestep 0 使 production run 步数干净从 0 起"
    example_status: needs_verification
    applies_to:
      tasks: [md_production]
    value: "reset_timestep 0"
    reason: "生产段步数独立计数便于后处理时间轴对齐"
parameter_relations:
  - target: read_restart
    relation: requires_companion
    desc: "read_restart 后常调用 reset_timestep 重置计数器"
    example_status: needs_verification

~~~yaml
record_id: lammps-cmd-run-0648
record_type: command
scope: single_software
software:
  - LAMMPS
topic: "run"
source_type: official_doc
source_ref: https://docs.lammps.org/run.html
version_or_doc_date: LAMMPS docs release git info 30Mar2026; checked 2026-05-21
claim: Official LAMMPS documentation lists "run" under General commands.
evidence_level: check
confidence: official
related_wiki: []
related_records:
  - lammps-cmd-timestep-0663
  - lammps-cmd-thermo-0658
  - lammps-cmd-dump-0589
note: >
  P4 深化。界面水 MD 标准: equil 100k + prod 200k (0.5 fs ts = 50+100 ps)。
last_checked: 2026-05-24
command_name: "run"
file_or_context: LAMMPS input script / LAMMPS command reference
definition: >
  启动 MD 运行——执行 N 个 MD steps。run 是 LAMMPS 输入脚本的核心执行命令。可延续运行（run 10000 → run 10000 再跑 1 万步）。常与 restart 文件配合实现分段跑。
default_behavior: >
  无默认——必须显式指定 steps。run 0 可用于验证输入脚本但不跑 MD。
common_use:
  - "MD production: run 200000（0.5 fs × 200k = 100 ps）"
  - "短测试: run 1000"
  - "分段跑: run 100000 → write_restart → run 100000"
risk_if_misused:
  - >
    steps 不是预先计算好的总模拟时长 → 生产跑完后发现采样不足
  - >
    run 前未设 thermo/dump → 跑了大量 steps 但无输出 → 浪费资源
  - >
    run + thermostat 未达平衡就开始 production sampling → 前段数据不能用
related_parameters:
  - timestep
  - thermo
  - dump
  - write_restart
source_index: https://docs.lammps.org/Commands_all.html
source_category: general
display_name: "run"
domain_guidance:
  - rule: "MD: run steps = 目标物理时长 / timestep; 先 equil 50 ps + prod 100 ps = 300k steps total"
    example_status: needs_verification
    applies_to:
      tasks: [md]
    value: "equil 100000 + prod 200000 (each run is resumable)"
    reason: "50 ps equilibration + 100 ps production = ~150 ps total"
parameter_relations:
  - target: timestep
    relation: mutually_constrained
    desc: "run steps × timestep = total simulation time"
    example_status: needs_verification
  - target: thermo
    relation: mutually_constrained
    desc: "run steps / thermo freq = log lines"
    example_status: needs_verification
  - target: dump
    relation: mutually_constrained
    desc: "run steps / dump freq = trajectory frames"
    example_status: needs_verification
~~~

record_id: lammps-cmd-thermo-0658
record_type: command
scope: single_software

topic: "thermo"
source_type: official_doc
source_ref: https://docs.lammps.org/thermo.html

claim: Official LAMMPS documentation lists "thermo" under General commands.
evidence_level: check
confidence: official
related_wiki: []
related_records:
  - lammps-cmd-thermo-style-0660

last_checked: 2026-05-24
command_name: "thermo"
file_or_context: LAMMPS input script / LAMMPS command reference
definition: >
  设置 thermo 输出频率（每 N 步输出一行热力学摘要到 log 文件）。thermo N 表示每 N 个 MD steps 输出一次。频率选择: 太频繁 → IO 瓶颈; 太稀疏 → 监控盲区太大。
default_behavior: >
  默认 thermo 1（每步输出，极其频繁，实际使用中需手动调整）。
common_use:
  - "短测试 (1k steps): thermo 1（实时监控）"
  - "MD equilibration: thermo 10（每 5 fs 输出）"
  - "production (100 ps+): thermo 100（每 50 fs 输出）"
risk_if_misused:
  - >
    thermo 1 + production run (1e6 steps) → 百万行 log → IO 成为瓶颈 + 硬盘写满
  - >
    thermo 过大 (如 10000) → 250 ps 跑完只有 50 行 log → 无法诊断问题
related_parameters:
  - thermo_style
  - dump
  - timestep
  - run
source_index: https://docs.lammps.org/Commands_all.html
source_category: general

    example_status: needs_verification
    applies_to:
      tasks: [md]
    value: "10 (equil) 或 100 (prod)"
    reason: "equil 需要高频监控温度收敛；production 低频即可"
parameter_relations:
  - target: thermo_style
    relation: requires_companion
    desc: "thermo 频率 × thermo_style 的输出量 = IO 负载"
    example_status: needs_verification

    relation: coupled_accuracy

    example_status: needs_verification
  - target: timestep
    relation: mutually_constrained
    desc: "thermo 频率 × timestep = 输出时间分辨率"
    example_status: needs_verification

claim: Official LAMMPS documentation lists "thermo_modify" under General commands.
evidence_level: check

related_records:
  - lammps-cmd-thermo-0658

note: >
  P4 深化。MD 建议 thermo_modify lost error 而非 lost ignore。
last_checked: 2026-05-24
command_name: "thermo_modify"
file_or_context: LAMMPS input script / LAMMPS command reference
definition: >
  修改 thermo 输出行为：指定使用哪个 compute 计算温度/压力/势能等热力学量（覆盖内部默认计算），设置 lost warn/ignore 处理丢失原子，norm yes/no 控制输出量是否除以原子数。
default_behavior: >
  默认用内部默认 compute 计算热力学量。lost warn 丢失原子时警告但不退出。
common_use:
  - "thermo_modify temp myTemp（使用自定义 temp compute 而非默认）"
  - "thermo_modify lost ignore flush yes"
risk_if_misused:
  - >
    thermo_modify lost ignore → 丢失原子静默忽略 → 轨迹错误但不报错
  - >
    使用的 compute-ID 未定义 → 报错
  - >
    thermo_modify norm yes 时输出已归一化 → 与未归一化比较时混淆
related_parameters:
  - thermo
  - compute
source_index: https://docs.lammps.org/Commands_all.html
source_category: general
display_name: "thermo_modify"
domain_guidance:

    example_status: needs_verification
    applies_to:
      tasks: [md]
    value: "lost error"
    reason: "potential 外推可能导致原子飞出——立即停止比静默忽略更安全"
parameter_relations:
  - target: thermo
    relation: requires_companion
    desc: "thermo_modify 修改 thermo 输出行为"
    example_status: needs_verification
  - target: compute
    relation: requires_companion
    desc: "thermo_modify temp 指定 temp compute"
    example_status: needs_verification

  - >

~~~yaml
record_id: lammps-cmd-timestep-0663
record_type: command
scope: single_software
software:
  - LAMMPS
topic: "timestep"
source_type: official_doc
source_ref: https://docs.lammps.org/timestep.html
version_or_doc_date: LAMMPS docs release git info 30Mar2026; checked 2026-05-21
claim: Official LAMMPS documentation lists "timestep" under General commands.
evidence_level: check
confidence: official
related_wiki: []
related_records:
  - rel-lammps-md-setup-chain-0001
  - rel-lammps-md-fix-thermostat-chain-0003
note: >
  P4 深化。MD 含 H 体系建议以 ≤0.5 fs 起步；须结合上游文档和目标运行环境验证。
last_checked: 2026-05-24
command_name: "timestep"
file_or_context: LAMMPS input script / LAMMPS command reference
definition: >
  设定 MD 时间步长。在 metal units 下单位是 ps（0.0005 = 0.5 fs）。timestep 是最关键的 MD 参数之一——过大则能量不守恒/原子飞出，过小则浪费计算资源。
default_behavior: >
  无默认，必须在 run 前显式设置。若无 timestep 命令则 LAMMPS 报错。
common_use:
  - "MD (含 H 的水体系): 0.0005 ps = 0.5 fs"
  - "纯金属/合金 MD: 0.001 ps = 1.0 fs"
  - "经典力场（非 ML）水: 0.001 ps = 1.0 fs"
  - "粗粒化模型: 0.005-0.01 ps = 5-10 fs"
risk_if_misused:
  - >
    timestep 过大 → 高频振动模式（O-H ~3600 cm⁻¹）能量不守恒 → 温度漂移/原子爆炸
  - >
    metal units 下误以为单位是 fs → timestep=0.5 → 实际 500 fs → 立即爆炸
  - >
    potential 对力精度敏感 → timestep 取保守值 0.5 fs（比经典力场更保守）
  - >
    timestep × run steps = 总时长——任一选错导致采样不足或资源浪费
related_parameters:
  - units
  - fix nvt/npt
  - neighbor
  - run
source_index: https://docs.lammps.org/Commands_all.html
source_category: general
display_name: "timestep"
domain_guidance:
  - rule: "含 H 的水/MD → timestep=0.5 fs (0.0005)"
    example_status: needs_verification
    applies_to:
      systems: [metal_water_interface, explicit_water, interfacial_water]
      tasks: [md, aimd]
    value: "0.0005"
    reason: "O-H 键振动周期 ~10 fs；timestep 需 ≤1/20 周期 → 0.5 fs 安全"
  - rule: "纯金属 MD → timestep=1.0 fs (0.001)"
    example_status: needs_verification
    applies_to:
      systems: [metal_slab, bulk_metal]
      tasks: [md]
    value: "0.001"
    reason: "金属 Debye 频率 ~200 cm⁻¹ → 周期 ~150 fs → 1 fs 足够采样"
parameter_relations:
  - target: units
    relation: mutually_constrained
    desc: "timestep 数值的物理含义由 units 决定"
    example_status: needs_verification
  - target: fix nvt/npt
    relation: mutually_constrained
    desc: "Tdamp ~ 100 × timestep；timestep 变了 Tdamp 也要变"
    example_status: needs_verification
  - target: neighbor
    relation: coupled_accuracy
    desc: "timestep 一小则 neighbor rebuild 不额外增加负担"
    example_status: needs_verification
  - target: run
    relation: mutually_constrained
    desc: "run steps × timestep = 总模拟时长"
    example_status: needs_verification
~~~

record_id: lammps-cmd-units-0667
record_type: command
scope: single_software
software:
  - LAMMPS
topic: "units"
source_type: official_doc
source_ref: https://docs.lammps.org/units.html
version_or_doc_date: LAMMPS docs release git info 30Mar2026; checked 2026-05-21
claim: Official LAMMPS documentation lists "units" under General commands.
evidence_level: check
confidence: official
related_wiki: []
related_records:
  - rel-lammps-md-setup-chain-0001
note: >
  P4 深化。metal units 是 MD 管线唯一推荐单位制。
last_checked: 2026-05-24
command_name: "units"
file_or_context: LAMMPS input script / LAMMPS command reference
definition: >
  LAMMPS 全局单位系统命令。设定输入脚本中所有物理量（长度、能量、时间、温度、压力、质量等）的单位制。必须在任何含物理单位的命令前设置，通常位于输入脚本第一行（在 atom_style 之前）。metal units: eV/Å/ps/K/bar/g/mol；real units: kcal/mol/Å/fs/K/atm/amu。
default_behavior: >
  默认 units lj（Lennard-Jones reduced units）。用户必须显式设置 units 为 metal 或 real。
common_use:
  - "金属/半导体/界面水 MD: units metal"
  - "有机/生物分子 MD (如用 CHARMM/OPLS 力场): units real"
risk_if_misused:
  - >
    units 未设为 metal 但使用 metal-style pair_coeff → 所有能量/力数值量纲错乱 → 模拟无物理意义
  - >
    timestep 单位混淆：metal units 下 0.001=1fs, real units 下 1.0=1fs — 差 1000 倍
  - >
    与 VASP/potential training 输出的单位不一致 → 跨软件数据传递出错
related_parameters:
  - timestep
  - pair_coeff
  - velocity
  - mass
source_index: https://docs.lammps.org/Commands_all.html
source_category: general
display_name: "units"
domain_guidance:
  - rule: "原子尺度金属/界面水 MD → units metal"
    example_status: needs_verification
    applies_to:
      systems: [metal_water_interface, interfacial_water, metal_slab]
      tasks: [md, md, lammps_md]
    value: "metal"
    reason: "与 VASP POSCAR/potential training 能量单位 (eV) 和长度单位 (Å) 一致"
parameter_relations:
  - target: timestep
    relation: mutually_constrained
    desc: "timestep 数值的物理含义由 units 决定。units metal: 0.0005=0.5fs; units real: 0.5=0.5fs"
    example_status: needs_verification
  - target: pair_coeff
    relation: mutually_constrained
    desc: "pair_coeff 的能量单位与 units 绑定。potential model 输出 eV → 必须 units metal"
    example_status: needs_verification
  - target: velocity
    relation: mutually_constrained
    desc: "velocity create 的温度单位和分布由 units 决定"
    example_status: needs_verification

last_checked: 2026-05-24
command_name: "variable"
file_or_context: LAMMPS input script / LAMMPS command reference
definition: >
  定义变量——在 input script 中存储字符串、数值或表达式。变量可用于参数化输入脚本（如温度、timestep 等）。类型: index（枚举值）、loop（循环计数）、equal（公式）、string（字符串）。
default_behavior: >
  variable <name> <style> <args>。
common_use:
  - "variable T equal 330"
  - "variable dt equal 0.0005"
  - "variable Nstep equal 200000"
  - "fix nvt all nvt temp $T $T 0.05"
risk_if_misused:
  - >
    equal 类变量含循环依赖 → 运行时错误
  - >
    变量名与 LAMMPS 关键词冲突 → 不可预期的替代
  - >
    immediate vs deferred 求值不明确 → 变量在错误时间被替代
related_parameters:
  - fix nvt
  - run
  - timestep
  - include
source_index: https://docs.lammps.org/Commands_all.html
source_category: general
display_name: "variable"
domain_guidance:
  - rule: "MD: 用变量参数化温度/timestep/步数 → 单点修改覆盖所有引用"
    example_status: needs_verification
    applies_to:
      tasks: [md]
    value: "variable T equal 330 ; fix nvt all nvt temp $T $T 0.05"
    reason: "参数化 → 改一行 = 全局改 → 减少错误"
parameter_relations:
  - target: fix nvt
    relation: requires_companion
    desc: "fix 中 $varname 引用变量值"
    example_status: needs_verification
  - target: run
    relation: requires_companion
    desc: "run $Nstep 引用步数变量"
    example_status: needs_verification
~~~

~~~yaml
record_id: lammps-cmd-velocity-0669
record_type: command
scope: single_software
software:
  - LAMMPS
topic: "velocity"
source_type: official_doc
source_ref: https://docs.lammps.org/velocity.html
version_or_doc_date: LAMMPS docs release git info 30Mar2026; checked 2026-05-21
claim: Official LAMMPS documentation lists "velocity" under General commands.
evidence_level: check
confidence: official
related_wiki: []
related_records:
  - rel-lammps-md-setup-chain-0001
  - lammps-fix-fix-nvt-0425
note: >
  P4 深化。重要：velocity create 要在 fix nvt 之前调用。
last_checked: 2026-05-24
command_name: "velocity"
file_or_context: LAMMPS input script / LAMMPS command reference
definition: >
  设置或生成原子初始速度。velocity create 从给定温度的高斯分布随机生成速度；velocity set 将特定原子速度设为零或指定值。通常用于 MD 初始化和 equilibration 阶段。
default_behavior: >
  无默认——若不设置 velocity，原子从零速度开始（非物理），需后续 thermostat 平衡。
common_use:
  - "velocity all create 330 12345 dist gaussian（330K Maxwell-Boltzmann 分布，随机种子 12345）"
  - "velocity all set 0.0 0.0 0.0（所有速度归零，用于 minimization 后重启）"
risk_if_misused:
  - >
    velocity create 的温度与 fix nvt Tstart 不一致 → 首步温度剧烈跳变 → 热冲击
  - >
    随机种子固定但不记录 → 结果不可复现
  - >
    minimize 后保留残余 velocity → 再跑 NVE 时动能非零 → 能量不匹配
related_parameters:
  - fix nvt
  - timestep
  - mass
  - units
source_index: https://docs.lammps.org/Commands_all.html
source_category: general
display_name: "velocity"
domain_guidance:
  - rule: "velocity create 温度 = fix nvt Tstart，避免热冲击"
    example_status: needs_verification
    applies_to:
      systems: [metal_water_interface]
      tasks: [md_equilibration]
    value: "velocity all create $T 12345 dist gaussian"
    reason: "一致的初始温度 + thermostat 温度 → 首步无温度峰"
parameter_relations:
  - target: fix nvt
    relation: strengthens
    desc: "velocity create 的温度与 fix nvt Tstart 一致时，equilibration 平滑"
    example_status: needs_verification
  - target: timestep
    relation: mutually_constrained
    desc: "timestep 越小 velocity create 产生的初始步位移越小"
    example_status: needs_verification
  - target: mass
    relation: requires_companion
    desc: "Maxwell-Boltzmann 分布需要正确的原子质量"
    example_status: needs_verification
~~~

~~~yaml
record_id: lammps-cmd-write-restart-0674
record_type: command
scope: single_software
software:
  - LAMMPS
topic: "write_restart"
source_type: official_doc
source_ref: https://docs.lammps.org/write_restart.html
version_or_doc_date: LAMMPS docs release git info 30Mar2026; checked 2026-05-21
claim: Official LAMMPS documentation lists "write_restart" under General commands.
evidence_level: check
confidence: official
related_wiki: []
related_records:
  - lammps-cmd-read-restart-0640
  - lammps-cmd-run-0648
note: >
  P4 深化。MD 推荐每段跑后 save restart 做 checkpoint。
last_checked: 2026-05-24
command_name: "write_restart"
file_or_context: LAMMPS input script / LAMMPS command reference
definition: >
  写入重启文件——保存 MD 当前完整状态（原子坐标、速度、力、fix 内部状态、随机种子等），使后续 run 可以无缝接续。与 dump 文件不同，restart 文件是二进制且包含所有内部状态。
default_behavior: >
  write_restart <filename> [keyword] — 保存到指定文件。
common_use:
  - "分段跑 checkpoint: write_restart restart.equil（每段跑后保存）"
  - "保存 equilibration 状态: write_restart restart.equil"
  - "从 equilibration restart: read_restart restart.equil → run production"
risk_if_misused:
  - >
    restart 文件不跨 LAMMPS 版本兼容——版本更换后可能无法读取
  - >
    restart 文件不跨 atom_style 兼容——改变 atom_style 后旧 restart 无法使用
  - >
    仅用 dump 文件恢复 → dump 不含速度和 fix 内部状态 → 无法真正续跑
related_parameters:
  - read_restart
  - run
source_index: https://docs.lammps.org/Commands_all.html
source_category: general
display_name: "write_restart"
domain_guidance:
  - rule: "MD 分段跑: equil 段末 write_restart → prod 段从 read_restart 启动"
    example_status: needs_verification
    applies_to:
      tasks: [md]
    value: "write_restart restart.equil ; ... ; read_restart restart.equil"
    reason: "restart 保留完整 MD 状态（包括 potential model 内状态、thermostat 状态）"
parameter_relations:
  - target: read_restart
    relation: requires_companion
    desc: "write_restart 的输出 = read_restart 的输入"
    example_status: needs_verification
  - target: run
    relation: mutually_constrained
    desc: "write_restart 在 run 之间做 checkpoint"
    example_status: needs_verification
~~~
